id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
Used to map data created internally to props.

Internal use only.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

includeRootRoute.description: Whether or not to treat a {@link UiSdlRoute} with urlPath "/" as part of these breadcrumbs

disablePreviousButton.description: Whether or not the Previous button should be disabled

breadcrumbs.description: This field  will be populated dynamically from routes

disableNextButton.description: Whether or not the Next button should be disabled

renderNextAndPreviousButtons.description: Whether or not to render the Next and Previous buttons

internalRedirect.description:
Whether or not to render the link (`<a>` tag) with a `redirect` class. This should
be set to `true` if you want take care of redirects with custom application logic.
Otherwise, if set to `false`, redirects will be handled automatically by the {@link UiSdlSite}.

visibleLevels.description:
The maximum number of breadcrumb levels to show on the component before overflowing.
When number of breadcrumbs are over this limit, the overflow is handled by hiding them in a dropdown.
Supported for AT LEAST 1 level.

title: A UI component type for breadcrumb that can be used to keep track of page navigation.
name: UiSdlBreadcrumbs
